# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Michael Roberts Estate Agents are delighted to introduce to the market this beautifully presented period property which is located on the highly sought-after North Circular Road and properties on this stretch of Road rarely frequent the market. "Snugboro" is an imposing four bed detached residence which is set off the road on a leafy elevated and private site.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 165.4 m²
- Energetická náročnost: Exempt
- Lokalita: "Snugboro", North Circular Road
- Cena: POA
